Third-party fonts in the Agent Docs drawing editor
==================================================

Package: @excalidraw/excalidraw 0.18.1 (npm, integrity
sha512-6i5Gt7IDTOH//qa0Z315Ly5iVRhjWpu2whrlQFqkuwrkKUWgRsMk0P5qdE7bpyDpai7jeLeWYkyj1eVAfni1lw==)

The files under fonts/ are copied unchanged from the package's dist/prod/fonts/. All 234 font files in that
directory are byte-identical to packages/excalidraw/fonts/ of the excalidraw/excalidraw repository at tag v0.18.1
(commit a2ec2889babf7d2295469c6d90ebe77fae57df84). Each font also carries its copyright notice in its name table.
The license texts in licenses/ are copied from the sources named below.


Excalidraw, the library that loads these fonts
  License: MIT, licenses/Excalidraw-MIT.txt
  Source:  excalidraw/excalidraw@a2ec2889babf7d2295469c6d90ebe77fae57df84 LICENSE

fonts/Excalifont/ (7 files): Excalifont, Version 1.000
  Copyright (c) 2024 by Excalidraw. All rights reserved.
  Excalifont is a trademark of Excalidraw.
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, licenses/Excalifont-OFL-1.1.txt
  Source:  excalidraw/excalidraw@a2ec2889babf7d2295469c6d90ebe77fae57df84
           packages/excalidraw/fonts/Excalifont/index.ts, which records the original font's name table: its
           copyright field (line 14) and license field (lines 26-116), without the "copyright: " and "license: "
           labels, separated by one empty line.

fonts/Virgil/ (1 file): Virgil, Version 001.001
  Copyright (c) 2011 by Your Own Font Foundry. All rights reserved.
  Virgil YOFF is a trademark of Your Own Font Foundry.
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1. The font's license field holds the full license text.
           licenses/Virgil-OFL-1.1.txt is the license of the font's repository.
  Source:  excalidraw/virgil@3d4c829dc85b455d4646631ac52bc1517df04217 LICENSE.md

fonts/Xiaolai/ (209 files): Xiaolai SC, Version 3.11, split into character subsets by Excalidraw
  Copyright (c) 2020 LXGW (the font's notice uses the copyright sign)
  Designer: Nozomi Seto
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, licenses/Xiaolai-OFL-1.1.txt
  Sources: excalidraw/excalidraw@a2ec2889babf7d2295469c6d90ebe77fae57df84
           packages/excalidraw/fonts/Xiaolai/index.ts, license field of the original font (line 231).
           lxgw/kose-font@172d9dbe94ade82b5316e0989e3aa286b7041baf OFL.txt (the copied license).
           lxgw/kose-font@39ba7ab3239fe976da5d68afc67082f4e22283d8 README.md (January 2021, after version 3.11)
           states the same license and lists the font's Reserved Font Names.

fonts/Cascadia/ (1 file): Cascadia Code, Version 2005.150
  (c) 2020 Microsoft Corporation. All Rights Reserved. (the font's notice uses the copyright sign)
  Cascadia Code is a trademark of the Microsoft group of companies.
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, licenses/CascadiaCode-OFL-1.1.txt
  Source:  microsoft/cascadia-code@0610f2df4356200adb93cb5bca2221b92ad6ee7e (tag v2005.15) LICENSE, with its
           CRLF line endings converted to LF. The font's own license field is the openTypeNameLicense of
           sources/CascadiaCode-Regular.ufo/fontinfo.plist at that tag: it opens with Microsoft's wording for fonts
           supplied with Microsoft products, then states that the OFL-based license applies and refers to this
           repository's LICENSE.

fonts/ComicShanns/ (4 files): Comic Shanns Mono 1.3.0, split into character subsets by Excalidraw
  License: MIT, licenses/ComicShanns-MIT.txt, the same text as each file's copyright field, with its copyright
           lines for Shannon Miwa (2018), Jesus Gonzalez (2023), Rodrigo Batista de Moraes (2023),
           Fini Jastrow (2024) and Kyle Beechly (2024).
  Source:  excalidraw/excalidraw@a2ec2889babf7d2295469c6d90ebe77fae57df84
           packages/excalidraw/fonts/ComicShanns/index.ts lines 14-38, without the "copyright: " label.
  Upstream: jesusmgg/comic-shanns-mono@9dfa787b1aa4800dbbdc1587db3b1b794b1a3b9b (tag v1.3.0) LICENSE.md, MIT.

fonts/Lilita/ (2 files): Lilita One, Version 1.002, Google Fonts subsets
  Copyright (c) 2011 Juan Montoreano, with Reserved Font Names "Lilita One" (the font's notice, which also gives
  a contact address; the license names the Reserved Font Name "Lilita")
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, licenses/LilitaOne-OFL-1.1.txt
  Source:  google/fonts@cc39c4c2c304bc368c9b7c311ea2bcc6013299fe ofl/lilitaone/OFL.txt

fonts/Nunito/ (5 files): Nunito, Version 3.602, Google Fonts subsets
  Copyright 2014 The Nunito Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/nunito)
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, licenses/Nunito-OFL-1.1.txt
  Source:  googlefonts/nunito@8c6a9bb9732545b9ed53f29ec5e1ab0ff53c4e6f OFL.txt
           (identical to google/fonts@cc39c4c2c304bc368c9b7c311ea2bcc6013299fe ofl/nunito/OFL.txt)

Assistant (4 files): Assistant, Version 3.000, the drawing editor's interface font
  Not in this folder: Excalidraw's stylesheet refers to these files, so the build emits them under /assets/ with
  the app's stylesheet.
  Copyright 2020 The Assistant Project Authors (https://github.com/hafontia/Assistant).
  Copyright 2010 The Source Sans Pro Authors (https://github.com/adobe-fonts/source-sans-pro), with Reserved Font
  Name 'Source'. Source is a trademark of Adobe Systems Incorporated in the United States and/or other countries.
  License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, licenses/Assistant-OFL-1.1.txt
  Source:  google/fonts@cc39c4c2c304bc368c9b7c311ea2bcc6013299fe ofl/assistant/OFL.txt


Not shipped: Liberation Sans, Version 1.05 (the package's fonts/Liberation/LiberationSans-Regular.woff2)
  Its license field says only "Use of this Liberation font software is subject to the license agreement under
  which you accepted the Liberation font software." and refers to http://www.ascendercorp.com/liberation.html.
  No license text for this version was found; the liberationfonts/liberation-fonts repository has tags only for
  2.x releases, and its OFL 1.1 license is theirs. Excalidraw uses this font only for text set to
  "Liberation Sans" (font family 9), which its font picker does not offer.
